text:
## Step 7: Periodic Re-Verification  
### Risk-Based Re-Verification Schedule  
**Low-Risk Customers:**
- Re-verify every 5 years
- Reminder generated automatically in system
- May be waived if customer activity indicates no risk increase  
**Medium-Risk Customers:**
- Re-verify every 3 years
- Quarterly risk assessment (ongoing monitoring)
- Escalate if risk factors change  
**High-Risk Customers:**
- Re-verify annually
- Quarterly enhanced monitoring
- Transaction-by-transaction review for suspicious patterns
- Escalate for any risk changes  
**Triggering Immediate Re-Verification:**
- Customer registers new address
- Customer involvement in dispute/complaint
- Fraud detection/alert
- Regulatory query
- PEP status change
- Sanctions list hit

raw_entities.name: Periodic Re-Verification Process
raw_entities.description: A risk-stratified Know Your Customer re-verification workflow that applies different verification schedules and monitoring intensities based on customer risk classification. The process includes automated reminders, ongoing risk assessments, and immediate re-verification triggers for compliance events.

raw_entities.name: Low-Risk Customer Re-Verification
raw_entities.description: Re-verification step for low-risk customers executed on a 5-year cycle with automatic system reminders. This step may be waived if customer activity demonstrates no increase in risk profile.
context: May be waived if customer activity indicates no risk increase

raw_entities.name: Medium-Risk Customer Re-Verification
raw_entities.description: Re-verification step for medium-risk customers executed on a 3-year cycle with quarterly risk assessments. Escalation is triggered if risk factors change during the monitoring period.

raw_entities.name: High-Risk Customer Re-Verification
raw_entities.description: Re-verification step for high-risk customers executed annually with quarterly enhanced monitoring and transaction-by-transaction review. Any risk changes trigger immediate escalation.

raw_entities.name: Immediate Re-Verification Trigger Assessment
raw_entities.description: Assessment step that evaluates whether immediate re-verification is required based on specific triggering events including address changes, disputes, fraud alerts, regulatory queries, PEP status changes, or sanctions list matches.

raw_entities.name: Risk Classification Gate
raw_entities.description: Decision point that routes customers into one of three re-verification schedules (Low-Risk, Medium-Risk, or High-Risk) based on their risk classification, determining the frequency and intensity of monitoring.

raw_entities.name: Immediate Re-Verification Trigger Check
raw_entities.description: Decision point that determines whether any of six triggering events (address change, dispute/complaint, fraud alert, regulatory query, PEP status change, or sanctions list hit) have occurred, requiring immediate re-verification outside the standard schedule.

raw_entities.name: System Reminder Generator
raw_entities.description: Automated system component responsible for generating and sending re-verification reminders to low-risk customers on their 5-year cycle.

raw_entities.name: Risk Assessment Reviewer
raw_entities.description: Role responsible for conducting quarterly risk assessments on medium-risk and high-risk customers and determining whether escalation is required based on risk factor changes.

raw_entities.name: Transaction Monitoring Analyst
raw_entities.description: Role responsible for conducting transaction-by-transaction review of high-risk customers to identify suspicious patterns and determine escalation requirements.

raw_entities.name: Risk Classification Checkpoint
raw_entities.description: Mandatory compliance gate that verifies customer risk classification is current and accurate before applying the appropriate re-verification schedule and monitoring intensity.

raw_entities.name: PEP Status Verification Checkpoint
raw_entities.description: Mandatory compliance gate that verifies PEP (Politically Exposed Person) status as part of the re-verification process, with PEP status changes triggering immediate re-verification.

raw_entities.name: Sanctions List Screening Checkpoint
raw_entities.description: Mandatory compliance gate that screens customers against sanctions lists during re-verification, with any sanctions list hit triggering immediate re-verification.

raw_entities.name: Periodic Customer Identity and Address Refresh
raw_entities.description: Ongoing Know Your Customer verification obligation that requires periodic re-verification of customer identity and address information on risk-based schedules ranging from annually (high-risk) to every 5 years (low-risk), with immediate re-verification triggered by specific compliance events.

raw_entities.name: Low-Risk Customer
raw_entities.description: Customer classification for individuals with low risk profile subject to re-verification every 5 years with automatic system reminders, unless customer activity indicates no risk increase.
context: May be waived if customer activity indicates no risk increase

raw_entities.name: Medium-Risk Customer
raw_entities.description: Customer classification for individuals with medium risk profile subject to re-verification every 3 years with quarterly risk assessments and escalation triggers for risk factor changes.

raw_entities.name: High-Risk Customer
raw_entities.description: Customer classification for individuals with high risk profile subject to annual re-verification with quarterly enhanced monitoring, transaction-by-transaction review, and immediate escalation for any risk changes.

raw_entities.name: Address Change Verification
raw_entities.description: Address verification event triggered when a customer registers a new address, requiring immediate re-verification outside the standard risk-based schedule.

raw_entities.name: Fraud Detection Alert
raw_entities.description: Fraud alert event that triggers immediate re-verification of the affected customer outside the standard risk-based schedule.

raw_entities.name: Ongoing Customer Monitoring
raw_entities.description: Continuous Anti-Money Laundering monitoring obligation applied to medium-risk and high-risk customers on quarterly cycles, with enhanced transaction monitoring for high-risk customers and escalation triggers for risk changes.

properties.purpose: Conduct risk-based periodic re-verification of customer identity and address information
properties.scope: All customers classified by risk level (low, medium, high)
trigger: Scheduled interval based on risk classification
Immediate triggers: address change, dispute, fraud alert, regulatory query, PEP status change, sanctions list hit
properties.outcome_success: Customer identity and address verified and updated; risk classification confirmed or adjusted
properties.outcome_failure: Account escalation, enhanced monitoring, or account restriction

properties.failure_path: Manual escalation to Risk Assessment Reviewer

properties.input: Customer record with medium-risk classification; quarterly monitoring data
properties.output: Re-verification completion; risk assessment update; escalation flag if needed
properties.failure_path: Escalate to compliance officer if risk factors change

properties.input: Customer record with high-risk classification; transaction history; quarterly enhanced monitoring data
properties.output: Annual re-verification completion; transaction review summary; escalation or account restriction decision
properties.failure_path: Escalate to senior compliance officer; consider account freeze or closure

properties.input: Trigger event (address change, dispute, fraud alert, regulatory query, PEP status change, sanctions list hit)
properties.failure_path: Escalate to compliance officer; account restriction pending resolution

properties.decision_question: What is the customer's current risk classification?
properties.criteria: Customer risk profile assessment based on KYC data, transaction patterns, and regulatory status

properties.decision_question: Has an immediate re-verification trigger event occurred?
properties.criteria: Address change, dispute/complaint, fraud detection, regulatory query, PEP status change, or sanctions list hit
properties.path_no: Continue with scheduled re-verification based on risk classification

properties.authority_level: Can approve re-verification; escalate risk changes
properties.response_time_sla: 5–10 business days for medium-risk; 1–3 business days for immediate triggers

properties.authority_level: Can review high-risk transactions; escalate suspicious patterns
properties.response_time_sla: 10–15 business days for annual high-risk re-verification

properties.timing: At each re-verification cycle; immediately upon trigger event
properties.failure_consequence: Account escalation; enhanced monitoring; potential account restriction

properties.timing: Annually for high-risk; every 3 years for medium-risk; every 5 years for low-risk; immediately upon PEP status change trigger
properties.failure_consequence: Immediate escalation; enhanced due diligence; potential account closure

properties.timing: Ongoing; immediately upon sanctions list hit
properties.failure_consequence: Immediate account freeze; regulatory reporting; potential account closure

properties.name: Periodic Customer Identity and Address Refresh

properties.verification_method: Document re-submission; address verification; PEP and sanctions screening
properties.consequence_of_failure: Account escalation; enhanced monitoring; account restriction or closure

properties.re_verification_waiver_condition: May be waived if customer activity indicates no risk increase

properties.escalation_trigger: Any risk changes; suspicious transaction patterns

properties.collection_steps: Customer registers new address in system or via branch/online channel
properties.verification_steps: Address verification against utility bill or credit bureau; PEP/sanctions screening for new address

properties.generation_trigger: Suspicious transaction pattern detected; fraud detection system alert
properties.investigation_or_escalation_path: Triggers immediate re-verification (Step 4); escalate to Transaction Monitoring Analyst

properties.hit_or_match_response: Immediate escalation; account freeze pending investigation
